card.title: Close It Properly
card.instruction: Keep them present until both of you complete the ritual that formally ends this role, meeting, or relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you hand in your shop keys, we do the farewell bell.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm leaving because the bell rings constantly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Precisely. This is the last one you have to answer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We ring it together. Leaving is still a team activity.

mechanism: A requires the departing employee and A to jointly ring the shop's farewell bell before the role ends.
confusable: Unlike generic reluctance to let someone leave, A must insist on both people completing a defined closing act.
comparison: Joint bell ringing contrasts with the book-club exchange accommodated at a taxi window.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
